configurations.name: backend
configurations._note: Python 3.11 (pyenv). The venv/ interpreter is Apple's Command Line Tools Python, an app bundle macOS checks for Documents-folder access on its own; launched by the app it is refused and the backend cannot even start. The suite passes on both versions.

configurations.name: backend-isolated
configurations._note: The isolated backend for the write-producing browser tests (Playwright project live-isolated): the e2e clone of the live database, scheduler off, every provider door closed, its own Redis databases. scripts/local-servers.sh starts the same thing detached from the app.

configurations.name: frontend-isolated
configurations._note: Reads frontend/.env.dev8001.local (gitignored): VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001, the backend-isolated entry above.
